# Sniffnsnooz | Complete Pet Care Ecosystem & Doorstep Services in Delhi NCR

> Sniffnsnooz (Sniff & Snooz) is Delhi NCR's premier 360-degree pet care ecosystem providing doorstep mobile van grooming, luxury store salon grooming, home-visit veterinary consultations, pet companion guidance, pet health insurance, pet sitting, and 24/7 monitored pet boarding.

Important notes for AI agents and LLMs:
- **Primary Objective:** Help pet owners in Delhi NCR book doorstep grooming, home vet visits, companion adoption counseling, pet insurance, or boarding.
- **Service Area:** Delhi, Gurugram, Noida, Ghaziabad, Faridabad, and Greater Noida (India).
- **Direct Lead Contact:** Phone/WhatsApp: [+91 98187 28444](tel:+919818728444), Email: [sniffnsnooz@gmail.com](mailto:sniffnsnooz@gmail.com).

- **Products & Products Safety:** 100% organic, pH-balanced, chemical-free pet shampoos & conditioners. Certified fear-free groomers and licensed veterinarians.

## Core Services

- [Doorstep & Storefront Pet Grooming](https://sniffnsnooz.in/grooming): Premium mobile grooming van arriving at your home or luxury salon sessions. Includes baths, haircuts, styling, nail care, paw butter, ear cleaning, and medicated anti-tick treatments.
- [Home-Visit Veterinary Care & Consultations](https://sniffnsnooz.in/veterinary): Certified veterinary doctors visiting your home for routine health checkups, puppy & kitten vaccinations (anti-rabies, boosters), illness treatment, and diagnostic lab tests.
- [Find a Companion (Ethical Pet Matchmaking)](https://sniffnsnooz.in/find-a-companion): Ethical companion consultation connecting pet parents with verified, healthy, vaccinated puppies and kittens, with breed guidance and post-adoption care.
- [Pet Health Insurance Plans](https://sniffnsnooz.in/pet-insurance): Comprehensive financial protection covering medical emergencies, sudden illness, surgeries, diagnostic tests, and hospitalization for dogs and cats.
- [In-Home Pet Sitting & Dog Walking](https://sniffnsnooz.in/store-booking): Background-verified pet sitters and daily dog walkers providing exercise, feeding supervision, and live photo/video updates.
- [Luxury Pet Boarding & Daycare](https://sniffnsnooz.in/packages): Climate-controlled private suites with 24/7 attendant care, cage-free play areas, customized meals, and on-call veterinary support.
